Name: Bigger Cave
Author: XiNaaru
Description:
This is not my own Mod. The original mod was created by [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/members/kingjoey.22946/]KingJoey[/url] from the Chucklefish forum. I have only made the ContentPatch for that, so that the original files are not attacked.

This Mods was replacing the orginal FarmCave.xnb in the Content/Maps Folder without delete the orginal file. If you want to use this mod, you need the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ 1.6.3 or higher.  

[b]Install:

[/b]1. Download and install [url=https://www.smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] 2.10.1 or higher
2. Download the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ 1.6.3 or higher and extract it in the Stardew Valley/Mods folger
3. Download now the .zip file here und extract.
4. Drag and Drop the folder BiggerCave to the Stardew Valley/Mods folder
5. Play and enjoy


This mod adds in the Farm Cave 2 more Floors. in the second floor is an Water Source and you can Farming here,
This is for the Standard Farm. If it Work on the other Farms, i dont Know.


You can Download the orginal Replace Mod at [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/bigger-cave-now-with-2-floors-and-farmable.109636/]Playstarbound[/url].

The fix was maked by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1552317]Pathoschild[/url]﻿. A Big Thanks!

[b]Bugs:

[/b]- In the cave a few rows do not seem to be plowed. Which are the please refer to the pictures.
